t: DEWALT DCD789P2T-GB 18V XR hammer drill driver supplied with 2 x 5.0Ah batteries. Brushless motor provides high efficiency and extended tool life while delivering 68Nm of torque for tough applications, with 15 torque settings available to offer ultimate control over delicate drilling and fastening tasks. Features heavy-duty construction, with ultra-compact, 164mm body, built for tight spaces (19% smaller than DCD778), making the tool ideal for all-day use by electricians, plumbers and carpenters working on busy jobsites. The lightweight 1.15kg design (without battery) also enables use in overhead areas. Equipped with a durable all-metal, 2 speed gearbox for versatile performance in wood, masonry and steel. Equipped with built-in LED work light to illuminate dark and confined work areas on site for improved accuracy. Rubber overmould grip enhances comfort during prolonged use. Supplied with batteries, charger and TSTAK carry case.
